purpose: Opinet fuel price synchronization contract for backend-only fuel price ingestion.

commands.name: sync_opinet_prices
commands.description: Reads OPINET_API_KEY from the backend environment and synchronizes public fuel price data around a selected WGS84 coordinate into FuelPrice rows with source=opinet.

arguments.--dry-run: Validate OPINET_API_KEY configuration without writing fuel price rows.
arguments.--health-check: Call the official avgAllPrice.do endpoint and report the returned row count without writing fuel price rows.
arguments.--latitude: Required for station-level sync. WGS84 latitude selected by the user or operator.
arguments.--longitude: Required for station-level sync. WGS84 longitude selected by the user or operator.
arguments.--radius-km: Optional station search radius. The current implementation caps Opinet aroundAll calls at 5km.
arguments.--fuel-type: Optional SmartFuel fuel type filter: gasoline, diesel, lpg, or premium_gasoline.

rules: The command must fail fast with a clear message when OPINET_API_KEY is missing.
The --health-check path may call avgAllPrice.do only to validate key/API reachability and must not write FuelPrice rows.
External API failure must not block local development or dummy station loading.
Fetched rows must be stored as FuelPrice(source=opinet).
Recommendation code must continue to use the latest stored FuelPrice row and must not call Opinet directly during recommendation requests.

stationLevelMapping.status: implemented for WGS84 selected location -> KATEC Opinet request -> WGS84 station storage

officialReferences.purpose: Fetch one station by Opinet UNI_ID with station metadata and OIL_PRICE rows.

officialReferences.purpose: Discover nearby Opinet station UNI_ID values by KATEC coordinate, radius, product code, and sort option.

fieldMapping.GasStation.name: OS_NM

coordinates.rule: Convert Opinet KATEC station coordinates to WGS84 before writing GasStation.latitude and GasStation.longitude.

FuelPrice.fuel_type.C004: unsupported for SmartFuel vehicle fuel recommendation

fieldMapping.FuelPrice.collected_at: TRADE_DT and TRADE_TM when available; otherwise command execution time in a later writing slice

requestTimeBoundary: Recommendation quote requests must not call Opinet endpoints.
The station refresh endpoint may call Opinet before a recommendation request to hydrate backend station data for the selected location.
The frontend must not call Opinet endpoints or receive OPINET_API_KEY.
Station-level Opinet synchronization may run through backend synchronization commands or the backend station refresh endpoint.
